highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The University of Tulsa is a private research university located in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Tulsa offers a close-knit campus experience and is known for its programmes in engineering, business, law, and the arts.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Whether you’re into academic or recreational activities, you’ll find a community or club at Tulsa. The university is home to over 100 student organisations and clubs. You can also meet people from all over the world.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university offers a range of modern and comfortable accommodation options on campus. You can choose from various types of university-managed residences, including traditional residence halls, suite-style living, Greek housing, apartments, and campus apartments.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The McFarlin Library at the university offers you several study spaces and extensive library resources, with online and physical materials to support learning.

Sports
You’ll find many sports facilities at the university, including the Mabee Centre for basketball and other events, a full fitness centre, and outdoor fields for soccer, tennis, and other recreational activities.

Laboratory
You’ll also find many state-of-the-art laboratories across various disciplines. From the Keplinger Hall for engineering students to the dedicated health science labs, you’ll have access to high-tech resources for hands-on learning and research.

Cafeteria
On campus, you can explore various food options at the LaFortune Student Centre, which has many dining venues.
